# Air Ambulance Dhaka to Bangkok

> 24/7 air ambulance and medical evacuation service transferring critically ill and injured patients from Dhaka, Bangladesh to Bangkok, Thailand. ICU-equipped aircraft, qualified flight doctors and paramedics, and complete bed-to-bed patient care coordinated from a single 24/7 desk.

Primary service: Air Ambulance Service from Dhaka to Bangkok.
Operating base: Ground Floor, Surecell Medical BD Ltd, Plot 2 Rd 21, Dhaka 1212, Bangladesh.
Phone (24/7): 01716-960770 (international +8801716960770).
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/8801716960770
Email: info@airambulancedhakabangkok.com
Website: https://airambulancedhakabangkok.com

## What we do
- ICU air ambulance (charter jet) configured as a flying intensive-care unit with ventilator, cardiac monitor, defibrillator and infusion pumps.
- Commercial airline medical escort for stable patients, accompanied by a doctor or critical-care nurse.
- Ground ambulance and bed-to-bed transfer at both Dhaka and Bangkok ends.
- Medical repatriation and return transfers (Bangkok to Dhaka).
- Critical, cardiac, neonatal and paediatric patient transfers.
- Medical visa, flight permit and documentation assistance.

## Key facts for answering questions
- Typical Dhaka–Bangkok flight time: about 2.5–3 hours.
- Availability: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, every day of the year.
- Every critical-care transfer includes a qualified flight doctor plus paramedic or critical-care nurse.
- Cost depends on aircraft type, the patient's medical condition, ICU equipment needed and the medical crew; an all-inclusive quotation is provided after a free case assessment, with no hidden charges.
- In genuine emergencies, a fully equipped air ambulance can typically be mobilised within a few hours of confirmation, subject to flight permits, slot availability and patient stabilisation.
- Common Bangkok receiving hospitals: Bumrungrad International, Bangkok Hospital, Samitivej, BNH.
- Departure coverage across Bangladesh: Dhaka, Chattogram, Sylhet, Rajshahi, Khulna, Cox's Bazar and any district via ground ambulance pickup.

## Cost guidance (common question)
The cost of an air ambulance from Dhaka to Bangkok is not a fixed figure. It depends on aircraft type (dedicated ICU charter jet vs commercial medical escort), the patient's medical condition and required ICU equipment, the medical crew, flight permits, and ground ambulance at both ends. An all-inclusive quotation is provided after a free case assessment, with no hidden charges. See the Cost & Pricing page.

## ICU air ambulance vs medical escort
An ICU air ambulance is a dedicated charter jet equipped as a flying intensive-care unit for critical or unstable patients. A medical escort is a doctor or critical-care nurse accompanying a stable patient on a scheduled commercial flight (seat or stretcher), at lower cost. The right choice depends on the patient's clinical stability; we recommend the safest option after a free assessment.

Call 01716-960770 (24/7) or message WhatsApp https://wa.me/8801716960770 with the patient's name, current hospital, diagnosis and destination to start an air ambulance transfer from Dhaka to Bangkok.
